# Recommendation

This folder contains clinical and methodological recommendations derived from the Danish Clinical Register of Emergency Surgery (AKDB) reports. It covers specific medical guidelines, such as the urgent use of contrast-enhanced CT scans for patients with suspected bowel ischemia, perforated hollow organs, or ileus, to ensure timely surgical intervention. Additionally, it includes strategic advice on adjusting national quality indicator targets in response to sustained improvements in healthcare performance.

## Pages

- [[recommendation|Recommendation]] — Clinical guidelines advising rapid contrast-enhanced CT scanning for acute abdominal conditions and proposing adjustments to quality indicator targets based on national performance trends.
